objective: Establish two equal project goals, honest acceptance criteria and synchronized public architecture documentation.
hypothesis: Pinned equal goals, evidence-based acceptance floors and generated architecture documentation can prevent silent goal drift without replacing visual judgment.
baseline: The README still calls artwork a test case; goals are scattered and diagram synchronization is manual. Independent preflight rejected unsupported numerical acceptance quotas.

result.summary: Established pinned equal ART and SYSTEM goals, generated GOALS.md, explicit acceptance evidence and a phase goal/protection gate. README goals and Mermaid architecture are generated from one manifest and checked against reviewed role/workflow inputs.6final contract tests pass after16worker affected checks. Fresh agent recovered all goals/statuses and caught a completion-before-process diagram bug, now fixed. Native GitHub Mermaid reviewed in two viewport captures. Both goals remain unfinished.
result.nextAction: Return to an independently challenged artwork experiment that targets the largest whole-view gap; use the new contracts instead of expanding infrastructure.

findings: Independent strategy review rejected unsupported numerical acceptance quotas; fresh-startup review also found a real diagram gate-order error. These are scoped useful decisions, not proof of general critic accuracy.
Goals, architecture source pins and generated documentation now have deterministic drift checks. Metadata and valid evidence paths cannot establish artistic acceptance or system efficiency.

Review setup exceeded estimates; native GitHub screenshot troubleshooting and this broad goal-contract change also exceeded the phase plan. Full-page iframe captures were discarded in favor of normal viewport evidence. No efficiency gain claimed.

actions.summary: Keep equal goal visibility, pinned acceptance definitions, source-pinned diagram generation and independent challenge.
Stop infrastructure expansion; use compact packets and existing bindings for the next bounded artwork test, with setup cost included.

review.nextImprovement: Challenge the largest remaining visual gap using native whole views; protect the SYSTEM goal by performing one cheap discriminating artifact test before wider validation.
